steps.code:
# Parse the file paths and move them to the new format
import re

base_dir = '~/documents/work/meetings_files/'
files_to_move = [f for f in files if not f.endswith('/')]

for file_path in files_to_move:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on "__" to get date and file_name_with_extension
    date_part, file_name_with_ext = filename.split('__', 1)
    # Split file_name_with_ext on last dot to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in file_name_with_ext:
        file_name, extension = file_name_with_ext.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name = file_name_with_ext
        extension = ''
    
    # Create destination directory: <file_name>/
    dest_dir = f"{base_dir}{file_name}/"
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dest_dir, recursive=True)
    
    # Destination file path: <file_name>/<date>.<extension>
    if extension:
        dest_file = f"{dest_dir}{date_part}.{extension}"
    else:
        dest_file = f"{dest_dir}{date_part}"
    
    # Move the file
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(
        access_token=access_token,
        source_file_path=file_path,
        destination_file_path=dest_file,
        overwrite=True
    )
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {dest_file}: {result}")
